title: Ledger entry
description: One row of the append-only JSONL ledger. sig_mldsa is an ML-DSA-65 signature (base64) over the canonical JSON of the entry without sig_mldsa (sort_keys, separators (',',':'), UTF-8). prev_hash is SHA-256 of the previous entry's canonical JSON including its signature; 64 zeros for the genesis entry.

payload_ref.description: Repo-relative path of the payload file whose SHA-256 is payload_hash.

pubkey_fp.description: SHA-256 of the signer's DER SubjectPublicKeyInfo.
